entry.title: New: tongflow#dsh-tongflow
entry.summary: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view. Exact install spec: dsh-tongflow. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
